message.content:
This editorial illustration features a mosaic image composed of hundreds of tiny, individual portraits. The background is white. Collectively, these small photographs form a larger, translucent portrait of a person’s face and shoulders, rendered in varied shades of blue and gray. Many of the people in the smaller portraits wear facial masks, stethoscopes, or white garments.

At the top, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, white serif capital letters with black outlines. Below this, smaller, illegible white text is centered. Near the bottom left, a white banner contains the black text "TOKOH PILIHAN 2020". Underneath, the words "PARA PAHLAWAN PANDEMI" are layered in large, bold, white sans-serif capital letters with black outlines.

At the very bottom left is a black QR code and a barcode with the numbers "00045" and "9 770126 427302". Adjacent text reads "28 DESEMBER 2020-3 JANUARI 2021", "RP 45.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273". The layout is vertically oriented and rectangular.
